title: Persist roster introductions and reconcile active Plants
verify: Migration/model tests prove native UUID PK/FK parity, ON DELETE RESTRICT, strict boolean/JSON constraints, unique batch and introduction keys, and rollback-safe sessions.
The production app uses the PostgreSQL FT-008 sink rather than UnavailableAgentIntroductionSink; test recording sinks remain explicitly test-only.
One strict batch commits one batch identity and exactly eight introduction UIFeedEvent rows, or commits zero; accepted and duplicate are durable only after a truthful committed state.
Identical retry preserves ids, canonical content, and original created_at; batch/item mismatch returns content_conflict with no partial mutation.
Startup/current-state reconciliation fills missing active-Plant introductions after failure or restart and converges under repeated runs without Bus copies or provider/model calls.

Archive racing bootstrap/reconciliation returns plant_not_publishable and writes nothing; retained rows survive archive, restore performs no automatic replay, and a later fresh active scan is idempotent.
Existing POST /api/plants request/auth/atomic Plant-grant-audit commit/201/no-store/error behavior remains unchanged after concrete sink composition.

verify.summary: Independent real-PostgreSQL verification passed focused and regression checks, 8-or-0 atomicity, retry/conflict/timestamp behavior, stale-scan archive denial, restore fresh-scan convergence, guarded migration rollback, full deterministic suite, lint, diff-check, and strict doctor. Per-task T3 semantic verdict is semantic-pass; HUMAN_CHECKPOINT remains pending.

Scheduler accepted independent VERDICT: PASS and SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass. The exact HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done marker was not fabricated; its process-only requirement was explicitly waived under the Constitution and project policy override. Product safety, authorization, data integrity, source-of-truth, scope, and destructive-action rules were not waived.

evidence_required: strict sink accepted duplicate rejected failed 8-or-0 matrix
archive race and post-restore fresh-scan evidence
focused and full deterministic test summaries
purpose: Replace the truthful unavailable FT-007 sink with durable PostgreSQL introduction delivery and restart-safe current-state reconciliation without changing Plant creation or creating agent context.
success_outcome: Every current active Plant converges to one durable canonical roster batch and exactly eight non-agent-consumable introduction UI Feed rows; retries, restarts, archive races, conflicts, and persistence failures remain atomic, idempotent, and fail closed with no Agent Chat Bus copy or false Plant rollback.
anti_goals: No Bus context query, classified MessageEnvelope publication, Plant feed HTTP endpoint, frontend, classifier, task, Safety Gate, Companion, or dataset effect.
No distributed broker, worker fleet, outbox, event sourcing, timeline replay, or provider/model call.
No public Plant-create request/response/error change and no reopening the Plant transaction around downstream delivery.

forbidden_scope: TASK-031 lifecycle, protocol, evidence, roster, UUID, provider, or MessageEnvelope changes
new infrastructure beyond the local PostgreSQL sink and startup reconciliation service
secrets, auth material, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or unapproved governance content
stop_conditions: The current FT-007 sink port or deterministic batch differs from the canonical roster/bootstrap contract.
Correctness would require changing POST /api/plants request/response/transaction semantics or reporting rollback after commit.
The sink cannot provide a single committed eight-or-zero result without partial acceptance.
Reconciliation would require timeline replay, a distributed broker, provider calls, or storing auth/provider content.

constraints: Use PostgreSQL/read-model rows with native UUID identities, matching FK types, restricted deletes, and one scoped Alembic migration.
Persist the strict canonical batch and eight introduction UIFeedEvent rows in one transaction and return the existing closed 8-or-0 result matrix.
Use introduction_id as ui_event_id and enforce uniqueness by plant_id, agent_id, and roster_version with canonical-content conflict detection.
Run reconciliation from current active Plant state and the existing deterministic roster builder; do not replay timeline or cache stale Plant state.
invariants: Introduction metadata is system presentation, never model output, MessageEnvelope, runtime authority, Agent Chat Bus context, or REQ-011 evidence.
Archived Plant admits no new projection; restore does not replay and only a fresh current-state reconciliation may continue.
Durable acceptance is never reported before commit and partial batch persistence is impossible.
Secrets, auth/session material, provider data, hidden reasoning, raw chat, and unapproved governance content never enter the rows or evidence.
verification_targets: Trace FT-008-BHV-001 and FT-008-BHV-002 to PostgreSQL integration tests covering duplicate, restart, archive race, restore without replay, and exactly eight UI rows.
